name: Lennart Johns
bio: Founding Dean of Clarkson University's Lewis School of Health Sciences, appointed in October 2020 after a nationwide search. He came from Quinnipiac University, where he chaired the Department of Athletic Training, served as interim chair of Diagnostic Imaging, and directed general education. A cellular and molecular biologist, he completed postdoctoral work at Bayer Pharmaceutical; his research covers autoimmunity and energy modalities, and he serves on the board of the North Area Health Education Center.
